comps.name: Aphelios Nidalee
comps.summary: A 4-Cost Fast 8 comp carried by Aphelios and Nidalee, with Sentinel tanking.
playWhen: You can reach level 8 on time with enough gold to roll for Aphelios
You have components for Red Buff

opener.note: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires.

stages.tip: Open with a strong win streak AD tempo around Rapidfires. BIS is somewhat fake in this comp so slam aggressively to win.
Comp can use many items so take item augment if you don't have one yet. Mama Beak can be a strong carry here if you have Riftbeasts online.
Level to 8 and roll heavily for Aphelios and the 4 costs. Only push for 9 once you have almost all your 4 costs upgraded.

comps.name: Eclipse Kayle
comps.summary: A 2-Cost Reroll comp carried by Kayle, with Sejuani tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Kayle and can slow roll at level 6
You have components for Guinsoo's Rageblade

opener.note: Ideally open with Kayle and upgraded frontline.

stages.tip: Ideally open with Kayle and upgraded frontline. After Rageblade, prioritize tank items. Econ up as much as possible.
Bench priority: Kayle 3 > Sejuani 3 > Leona 3 > Shen 3 / Varus 3. Once you finish Kayle 3, begin pushing levels for Lunar units.
Finish your 3* and level for Lunar units to get Eclipse in. Lunar Lux or Solar Lux are both good.

comps.name: Invoker Morgana
comps.summary: A Lose Streak comp carried by Morgana and Brambleback, with Sentinel tanking.
playWhen: Your board and items point toward Morgana
You have components for Morellonomicon

opener.note: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Invokers.

stages.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Invokers. Teemo is an example shown but you can also play Pebbles, Spellweavers, or Coven.
If lose streaking with Coven, try to kill some units each fight to preserve HP. If win streaking, push standard winstreak tempo (6 @ 3-2, 7 @ 3-5) and save econ.
Cash out / roll down on level 8 for Morgana 2, Sentinel, and 4 Invoker. If you don't have Bramble items, flex in another AP carry like Ahri / Nidalee.

comps.name: 6 Juggernaut Flex
comps.summary: A 4-Cost Fast 8 comp carried by Amumu, Sivir and Zyra.
playWhen: You can reach level 8 on time with enough gold to roll for Amumu
You have components for Warmog's Armor

opener.note: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom.

stages.tip: Open with a strong AP opener, preferably around Blossom. Slam generic AP items and Tank items for a win streak.
Ideally start holding more juggernauts to pair with the Yorick blossom opener, consider moving karma items to LB or Cassio 2.
Level and roll for 6 juggernauts +Zyra and a duo-carry. You can push 9 when you hit zyra 2. Tank Vi 2 over Amumu 1. End game move items to Maokai.

comps.name: Dragon 9
comps.summary: A Fast 9 comp carried by Elder Dragon and Ivern, with Morgana tanking.
playWhen: You have the economy to reach level 9 and find Elder Dragon
You have components for Infinity Edge

opener.note: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Riftbeast items.

stages.tip: Slam items aggressively and play for full win streak with Riftbeast items. Ideal opener will be Riftbeasts featuring Cinderling / Gromp / Mama Beak carry.
Continue prioritize win streaking. If you have an econ augment, you can go Fast 7 (before 3-3) to maintain win streak if needed.
You can start losing rounds while focusing on econ. Fast 9 by the beginning of Stage 5 and look for your 5 costs. You want around 70g+ minimum for the rolldown.

comps.name: Yi Rengar
comps.summary: A 3-Cost Reroll comp carried by Master Yi, Rengar and Nidalee, with Vi tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Master Yi and can slow roll at level 7
You have components for Edge of Night

opener.note: Ideally play around a Rengar opener that can win streak.

stages.tip: Ideally play around a Rengar opener that can win streak. Blossom is very powerful to get early econ or item wisps.
Add more Adaptors and frontline as you go. Finish Yi/Rengar items by end of stage. You can even play 5 Blossom for maximum Wisp greed if you highroll the 4 costs.
Level to 7 and roll for Master Yi 2, Rengar 2, and a Juggernaut Tank. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. Add Kog or a flex unit in at 8.

comps.name: Elderwood Executioners
comps.summary: A 4-Cost Fast 8 comp carried by Ezreal and Soraka, with Hecarim tanking.
playWhen: You can reach level 8 on time with enough gold to roll for Ezreal
You have components for Spear of Shojin

opener.note: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah.

stages.tip: Open with upgraded Elderwood and slam items on LeBlanc or Xayah. LeBlanc can farm copies of units on your board so avoid fielding unwanted units.
Add more Elderwood as you level with Spellweavers. If you start getting AD items, play them on Xayah / Rapidfires.
Level to 8 and look for Ezreal and Soraka with 7 Elderwood. Try not to roll to 0g because we need gold to get to level 9.

comps.name: Ashe Juggernauts
comps.summary: A 4-Cost Fast 8 comp carried by Ashe and Sivir, with Amumu tanking.
playWhen: You can reach level 8 on time with enough gold to roll for Ashe
You have components for Spear of Shojin

opener.note: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara.

stages.tip: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara. Slam generic AD items and Tank items for a win streak.
Level up for more juggernauts and executioners to pair with our blossom opener.
Level and roll for 6 juggernauts +Sivir. Once stable, go 9 and look for Ashe and transition your board to 5 costs.

comps.name: Solar Melee
comps.summary: A 1-Cost Reroll comp carried by Akali, Camille and Varus, with Ornn tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Akali and can slow roll at level 5 or 6
You have components for Jeweled Gauntlet

opener.note: Look to play with lots of early copies of 1 cost + good reroll augment.

stages.tip: Look to play with lots of early copies of 1 cost + good reroll augment.
Roll to 30 on 3-1 level 4 for extra 1 cost copies. Then slow roll on 5 until you have 5 3 stars for solar bonus.
Make sure you keep your econ high because you need to be level 7 to fit solar on this board. Try to be Level to 7 somewhere on stage 4.

comps.name: Teemowood
comps.summary: A 2-Cost Reroll comp carried by Teemo and LeBlanc, with Alistar tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Teemo and can slow roll at level 6
You have components for Void Staff

opener.note: Open with a win streak Teemo start and itemize him ASAP.

stages.tip: Open with a win streak Teemo start and itemize him ASAP. The more Teemo casts, the more likely you can collect value off his mushrooms.
Level to 6 and roll for your 2* upgrades to stabilize and win streak Stage 3. Econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Finish Teemo 3* and your tank then push levels for more Invokers. If you get more damage items late game Morgana can hold the utility.

comps.name: Invoker Nidalee
comps.summary: A 4-Cost Fast 8 comp carried by Nidalee, with Morgana tanking.
playWhen: You can reach level 8 on time with enough gold to roll for Nidalee
You have components for Jeweled Gauntlet

opener.note: Play any strong Rageblade opener on an AP carry such as Kayle, Master Yi, or a Spellweaver.

stages.tip: Play any strong Rageblade opener on an AP carry such as Kayle, Master Yi, or a Spellweaver. Opener is very flexible.
Comp is very Rod hungry so keep taking them off augments / carousels when possible. If you are not playing Invokers, hold onto cheap units like Pebbles for later.
Level to 8 and roll for 4 Invoker. Avoid tunneling only on 4 Vanguard frontline. You can also flex Brawlers or Juggernauts as needed.

comps.name: Warwick Reroll
comps.summary: A 2-Cost Reroll comp carried by Warwick, with Malphite tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Warwick and can slow roll at level 6
You have components for Sterak's Gage

opener.note: If you don't have Shojin, consider lose streak to guarantee it on carousel.

stages.tip: If you don't have Shojin, consider lose streak to guarantee it on carousel. If you have Shojin + good component, play for win streak instead.
Level to 6 and roll for Warwick 2 with 4 Blackthorn + 2 Ravager. Econ up and slow roll for 3*. You can also play 4 Ravager temporarily if needed.
Finish Warwick 3 and push levels. If you don't have Murkwolf 3, look for Brambleback as your duo carry.

comps.name: Rengar Reroll
comps.summary: A 3-Cost Reroll comp carried by Rengar and Mama Beak, with Hecarim tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Rengar and can slow roll at level 7
You have components for Edge of Night

opener.note: Only play this comp with an early Rengar with items so you can snowball Rival.

stages.tip: Only play this comp with an early Rengar with items so you can snowball Rival. Play any upgraded frontline tank to stall for Kha'zix.
If you have a few crucial pairs on level 6, you can consider rolling slightly on 6 to get charms / upgrade units. Econ up to 7 otherwise.
Slow roll on 7 for 3* upgrades on whatever 3 costs you're chasing. In this example, if you can't hit Mama Beak 3, look for Aphelios duo instead.

comps.name: Solara Yunara
comps.summary: A 2-Cost Reroll comp carried by Yunara and Karma, with Sejuani tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Yunara and can slow roll at level 6
You have components for Deathblade

opener.note: Slam items for Yunara and play for win streak with Blossom in.

stages.tip: Slam items for Yunara and play for win streak with Blossom in. Tank Yorick / Juggernaut until you find Sejuani 2.
Level at 3-2 and roll for 2* upgrades then econ up. Roll for all the 3* shown on the build + Azir. Try to avoid rolling to 0 gold because you need gold for leveling later.
Finish your 3* then level for 3 Solar over time. Leftover AP items on LeBlanc. Karma 3 can also hold items too.

comps.name: Coven Elise
comps.summary: A 2-Cost Reroll comp carried by Elise, Morgana and Cassiopeia.
playWhen: You find early copies of Elise and can slow roll at level 6
You have components for Titan's Resolve
Situational: Play with Dark Ritual augment to convert cash out -> AP.

opener.note: Ideally open with Coven and start gathering Essence.

stages.tip: Ideally open with Coven and start gathering Essence. It is actually better to win early than lose for stacks so don't overly force lose streak.
Level to 6 and roll for a Elise 2, Covens, and Vanguards. Give Cassio or Diana leftover AP. Cash out Coven and convert to AP with at least 2-3 lives (25-30 hp).
Finish Elise 3 / Cassio 3 then level for more Vanguards or Lunar. Play 2 Morganas with items if you have extra.

comps.name: Trait Ladder
comps.summary: A Fast 9 comp carried by Fiddlesticks and Aphelios.
playWhen: You have the economy to reach level 9 and find Fiddlesticks
You have components for Warmog's Armor
Situational: Hard flex composition, but very strong when played well.

opener.note: Ideally start with Khazix to get 10 takedowns ASAP.

stages.tip: Ideally start with Khazix to get 10 takedowns ASAP. Add in the cheap 1-2 cost units to activate traits. Otherwise, flex around your best upgraded unit.
Continue adding and flexing in more traits. +1 team size augments like Coronation or Cursed Crown are very OP here.
After you hit 11 traits, add Amumu with the Tactician's Crown you get and then level for Kennen. Then pivot to 5 costs at level 9.

comps.name: Inferno Fast 9
comps.summary: A 4-Cost Fast 8 comp carried by Lux and Ashe, with Amumu tanking.
playWhen: You can reach level 8 on time with enough gold to roll for Lux
You have components for Spear of Shojin
Situational: Only play with Inferno emblem.

opener.note: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara.

stages.tip: Open with a strong AD opener, preferably around Yunara. Slam generic AD items and Tank items for a win streak. You can also play around Varus/Akali 2 with AD items.
Level and add more Juggernauts and Executioners. Make sure to hold Inferno units along the way. Can also play 3 Inferno for shop high rolls.
Roll on 8 for 5 inferno Sivir + Vi + Lillia + Hunter (can play Tristana before Ashe). When you find Ashe make sure to give her inferno emblem + shojin.

comps.name: Moo-nara
comps.summary: A 2-Cost Reroll comp carried by Yunara and Warwick, with Alistar tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Yunara and can slow roll at level 6
You have components for Spear of Shojin
Situational: Play when you have lots of copies of Yunara with Blackthorn emblem.

opener.note: Slam items for Yunara and play for win streak with Blossom in.

stages.tip: Slam items for Yunara and play for win streak with Blossom in. Tank Yorick / Juggernaut until you find Alistar.
Level at 3-2 and roll for 2* upgrades then econ up. Skip Azir 2 because he's too expensive. Buy a charm every round if possible and win streak.
Finish your 3* units then push levels. Look for 3 Executioner for Yunara. Kennen caps your board. Blackthorn Lux is a high roll top end finisher.

comps.name: Emblem Rengar
comps.summary: A 3-Cost Reroll comp carried by Rengar and Tristana, with Rammus tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Rengar and can slow roll at level 7
You have components for Edge of Night
Situational: Only play when you have emblem for Rengar.

opener.note: Play for win streak with Rengar and the emblem.

stages.tip: Play for win streak with Rengar and the emblem. Position him same side as enemy carries to get backline snipes.
Keep snowballing with Rengar. Take an item augment if you aren't on track to get 3 items by end of Stage. Rengar only performs as well as your best tank so prioritize frontline too.
Level to 7 and roll above 50g for 3* Rengar and 3* Rammus. Use your 4 Fae cash outs to push levels. Tristana takes leftover items.

comps.name: Veigar Consuming Flora
comps.summary: A 1-Cost Reroll comp carried by Veigar, with Rek'Sai tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Veigar and can slow roll at level 5 or 6
You have components for Jeweled Gauntlet
Situational: Very strong with Dawncore and Ludens as well.

opener.note: Only play around this opener with early upgrades so Veigar can snowball and gain stacks.

stages.tip: Only play around this opener with early upgrades so Veigar can snowball and gain stacks. Prioritize Veigar items.
If you are close to Veigar 3 (7+ copies), consider rolling until you hit 3*. If far (3-4 copies), slow roll above 50g for 3*.
Once you finish your 3*, push levels for more Spyrkin, Blackthorn, or Brawlers.

comps.name: Ravager Elise
comps.summary: A 2-Cost Reroll comp carried by Elise, with Diana tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Elise and can slow roll at level 6
You have components for Titan's Resolve
Situational: Very strong with Ravager emblem.

opener.note: Ideally open with Coven and start gathering Essence.

stages.tip: Ideally open with Coven and start gathering Essence. It is actually better to win early than lose for stacks so don't overly force lose streak.
Level to 6 and roll for a Elise 2, Covens, and another Ravager. If AD items, look for Murkwolf. If AP items, look for Dianas.
Cash out Coven with at least 2-3 lives (25-30 hp). Finish Elise 3 then level for more Vanguards, Coven, or Lunar / 5 costs.

comps.name: Fae Tristana
comps.summary: A 3-Cost Reroll comp carried by Tristana and Sivir, with Rammus tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Tristana and can slow roll at level 7
You have components for Guinsoo's Rageblade
Situational: Only play when you have Fae emblem.

opener.note: Play for win streak with upgraded Rageblade holder.

stages.tip: Play for win streak with upgraded Rageblade holder. Start stacking Fae since getting to 7 ASAP is crucial for success.
Itemize and play Tristana as soon as you find her. Sprykin is more important than Hunter. If you spike very early Primal from ahead, you can consider items.
Level to 7 and roll above 50g for 3* Tristana and Rammus. Use your 4 Fae cash outs to push levels. Give Sivir leftover AD items.

comps.name: Unrivaled Reroll
comps.summary: A 3-Cost Reroll comp carried by Kha'Zix and Rengar, with Hecarim tanking.
playWhen: You find early copies of Kha'Zix and can slow roll at level 7
You have components for Hand Of Justice
Situational: Ideally, Khazix gains Ravager > Executioner > Rapidfire > Spellweaver with takedowns.

opener.note: Items are crucial for this composition so focus on Edge of Night first.

stages.tip: Items are crucial for this composition so focus on Edge of Night first. Play any upgraded frontline tank to stall for Khazix + Rengar.
Keep adding more frontline. Rengar and Khazix will only be effective as your best tank. Item augments are huge to keep your momentum.
Level to 7 and roll for the 2* upgrades. Then econ up and slow roll above 50g for 3* units. Once you finish 3* tank + Khazix 3 / Rengar 3, add 5 costs.
